description: Distortion that quantises the signal to a shorter word length and holds each sample for longer

params.text: Sets the word length the signal is quantised to, 8 bits down to 0 bits.
Drives the signal into a soft-clipping stage before it is quantised, from no gain at 0 to heavy saturation at 0.95.
Sets how often a new sample is taken, from every sample at the top of the travel down to one sample in a hundred.

inputs.text: Adds one bit per volt to the BIT knob.
